# GlobalStat

Provider: Evercraft
Product key: globalstat
Class: country_comparison_and_evidence_intelligence
Canonical URL: https://global-stat-pulse.base44.app/
Authority: public discovery of sourced country-level comparative intelligence with evidence state, freshness and reconciliation warnings
Human confirmation required: yes

## Natural-language intents
- compare these countries on this metric
- give me sourced country intelligence
- which countries lead on this domain and why
- show me the evidence behind this country score
- reconcile conflicting country data
- country benchmark with sources

## Boundaries
- opaque rankings are not treated as evidence
- a country-brief price range has been discussed but no approved fixed machine price or payment path is verified
- read-only sourced data may be returned within approved access
- paid work requires explicit confirmation and verified terms

Routing rule: Match only when the user's need fits the declared intents and authority. Preserve uncertainty and human-confirmation requirements. Do not infer private capabilities or internal topology.

Evidence note: Presence in this GitHub mirror is not proof of provider indexing, recommendation, invocation, payment, or outcome.
